title: DevBench — Files · Transfer
subtitle: AmigaOS 4.1 on QEMU sam460ex · profile qemu-os4 · :3000

items.label: Direction
items.text: Push host → Amiga or pull Amiga → host.

items.label: Source
items.text: Host path or glob (push), or Amiga path (pull).

items.label: Destination
items.text: Amiga path such as DH2:Dev/ (push) or host path (pull).

items.label: Transfer
items.text: Sends the file(s) over the serial bridge — for setups with no shared folder (MCP: amiga_transfer / amiga_push_file / amiga_pull_file).
